<translate>
The '''Sacred Kai Planet''' (the Sacred World of the Kais, dimension id <code>dragonminez:sacredkaiplanet</code>) is a lush, otherworldly planet, home of the Kais. It's a decorative, lore world rather than a mining destination, and the place where you meet [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]] and face his Ultimate Challenge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gravity ==
</translate>
{{Config|Gravity Config|defaultWorldGravity}}
<translate>
Gravity is normal (×1.0) by default. The planet isn't listed in the per-world gravity setting, so it uses the fallback world gravity.
</translate>

<translate>
== Biomes ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Sacred Kai Plains''', where [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Old Kai's Pillar]] stands
* '''Sacred Kai Hills'''
* '''Sacred Kai Rivers'''
</translate>

<translate>
== Blocks and resources ==
</translate>
<translate>
The Sacred Kai Planet has no ore set of its own. Its signature blocks are the '''Sacred wood''' set (log, planks, stairs, doors and more), '''Sacred grass''', a range of '''Sacred flowers''' (amaryllis, catharanthus, chrysanthemum, marigold and trillium) and '''Sacred ferns'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== Creatures ==
</translate>
<translate>
* '''Vanilla animals''': pigs, sheep, mooshrooms, chickens, rabbits, horses and donkeys, plus fish, axolotls and guardians in the water.
* '''Hostiles''': [[Special:MyLanguage/Mini Buu|Mini Buu]] and Endermen.
</translate>

<translate>
== Old Kai's Pillar ==
</translate>
{{Main|Old Kai's Pillar}}
<translate>
[[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai's Pillar|Old Kai's Pillar]] in the Sacred Kai Plains is the home of [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]], the master tied to unlocking your hidden potential. His '''Unleash Power''' service starts the Ultimate Challenge, which unlocks the Ultimate form and gives you the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z Sword]] (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames#Old Kai's Ultimate Challenge|Training Minigames]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting there ==
</translate>
<translate>
Travel by [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]]. The '''Sacred Kai Planet''' destination unlocks once you complete [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 23, ''Gotenks at Full Power''. The pod lands you at the same X, Y and Z you left from.
</translate>

<translate>
The final battles of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] take place here, and the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] sends you back to talk to Old Kai.
</translate>
